scenario_confirmation_interactions.question: When platform receipts or token telemetry are missing and historical evidence needs migration, should the workflow infer values, block all work, or degrade honestly and append corrections?
options: record unavailable/evidence levels and use append-only corrections
scenario_confirmation_interactions.recommendation: record unavailable/evidence levels and use append-only corrections
scenario_confirmation_interactions.user_response: The originating CR request explicitly requires unavailable rather than synthesized receipts/telemetry and an append-only CR-163 evidence pilot with immutable business implementation.
scenario_confirmation_interactions.confirmed_understanding: Unknown facts remain unavailable; corrections and supersessions are appended; quant-lab lineage business code is not changed.
